description: This Java class 'GlobalConfigurationScenarioInitializerStep' implements the 'FineractScenarioInitializerStep' interface. It initializes global configuration settings for a testing scenario by enabling and disabling certain global configuration flags, using a helper class. The class is annotated with Spring's '@Component' and Lombok's '@RequiredArgsConstructor', and overrides a method to perform configuration setup tasks.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationScenarioInitializerStep
classes.description: A Spring component class that initializes specific global configurations for test scenarios by enabling or disabling certain flags.

methods.name: initializeForScenario
methods.description: Overrides the method to set up global configurations; disables address configuration and enables business date and recalculate COB date configurations.
